mentions.name: Datapoint Watchlist
mentions.description: This app provides a watchlist for tracking any kind of datapoint over time — stocks, weather, air quality, macro indicators, and more — so users can keep one watchlist for all the different numbers they're interested in. It supports followup comparisons with peers or with past values.
mentions.problem: Started from exploring economic data and wondering if there was a simple way to keep an eye on a particular datapoint over time, and whether one watchlist could cover all the different numbers a person is interested in.
